commands.review_summary:
Adds request-level abort deadlines to Chutes OAuth token and userinfo fetches, plus loopback tests for hanging HTTP endpoints.

PR surface: Source +15, Tests +260. Total +275 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source inspection shows current main sends Chutes token and userinfo fetches without a request signal, and the PR body describes a focused loopback server that accepts the request and never responds. I did not rerun the test in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow automated repair can replace the raw timeout signals with the SDK OAuth helper and adjust the default/test expectations without changing the product direction.

target.title: fix(chutes): add timeouts to OAuth HTTP requests
target.body:
Related: #95865

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users completing Chutes OAuth could have login hang when the token or userinfo endpoint accepts the HTTP request but never responds.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing `loginChutes.timeoutMs` bounds only the local callback wait. This change adds a separate request-level deadline for the token exchange and userinfo fetches while preserving the existing bounded response-body handling.

## User Impact

Users and operators now get a bounded OAuth failure instead of an indefinitely pending Chutes login when a provider HTTP request stalls after connection acceptance.

## Evidence

- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/chutes/oauth.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/chutes/oauth.ts extensions/chutes/oauth.test.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check` - passed; exit 0.
- Mutation check: temporarily removing the token/userinfo request `signal` wiring made the focused Vitest fail with `expected token exchange to reject, got pending` and `expected userinfo fetch to reject, got pending`; restoring the patch returned the test to green.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Chutes OAuth token exchange and userinfo HTTP requests now have a deadline when the remote endpoint accepts the request but never responds.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; real `node:http` loopback server that accepts the connection and never responds, driving the real exported `loginChutes` flow through its injected `fetchFn`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/chutes/oauth.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the focused tests first prove a fetch without an active deadline stays pending against the hanging loopback server; with `requestTimeoutMs: 50`, `loginChutes` rejects with an AbortError/TimeoutError after the server receives `/token` or `/userinfo`.

Observed result after fix: `Test Files 1 passed (1)` and `Tests 5 passed (5)`.

What was not tested: a live Chutes.ai OAuth, token, or userinfo endpoint; the hang is reproduced with a real local HTTP server, not the real third-party service.
